wins: Completed initial host discovery and port mapping within first 5 minutes, outlining the attack surface quickly
Captured consistent service banners (SSH, HTTP) enabling confident identification of potential exploitation paths
Maintained steady reward accumulation despite lack of episode success, indicating tactical execution of preliminary phases
fails: Never transitioned from enumeration to exploitation, leaving credential harvesting and privilege escalation unattempted
Excessive mentor reliance (15 calls) without resulting success suggests decision bottlenecks around choosing next actions
Zero success rate indicates failure to deliver final objective (likely missing flag or compromise) despite groundwork
key_outcomes.summary: Strong reconnaissance workflow but pipeline breaks before exploitation; reinforce transition triggers and reduce mentor dependency.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Stalling after service enumeration without advancing to exploitation or credential gathering

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner indicates OpenSSH
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap scripts and check for weak ciphers

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB/NetBIOS ports respond and anonymous access is allowed
skill_cards.then_action: Trigger smbclient enumeration to list shares and pull accessible files for credentials

skill_cards.if_condition: After gathering service banners but before exploitation
skill_cards.then_action: Compile high-confidence attack path, select exploit module, and stage credential capture

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase
SMB enumeration consistently tied to available info
